name: pilgrimage
scope: Pilgrimage makes Goldwind the fresh-settings default and adds two seeded chapter families: The Lantern Causeway and The Ashen Archive. Authored modules carry ordinary routes, conditional crossings, firing lanes, supported Blink landings, service shortcuts and role-based encounters. Geometry, encounter, loot and decoration randomness are independent. Existing explicit Classic preferences, three legacy layouts, old runs and rewards remain.
saveCompatibility: Goldwind is the fresh-settings default; an explicitly saved Classic choice is respected. New chapter saves freeze generator identity, seed, tier and mechanism state. All three older layout readers, profile/envelope keys, one-time reward receipts and old-run continuation are retained. The new route ends in retained Endless after two chapters.
hardwareStatus: Development release. Model samples and input-driven native/public WebGL verification are separate from physical Quest 3/Xbox, comfort, sustained performance and human comprehension. New chapters use representative original graybox-first architecture, not finished biome art.
